svg.text: 569 of 873 resource nodes, by the county ERCOT's CDR gives the units at their station (ercot_node_places).
304 are not placed and not drawn. Counties outside ERCOT are drawn too, unshaded.
Design frame, session 1049, not on the site. Counties: us-atlas (Census cartographic boundaries). Most nodes in one county: 25.
A county's shade is a count of nodes, not a node's location.
